Original VirelaiOS PNG vectors, repository LICENSE.

type-{0,2,3,4,6}-filter-{0,1,2,3,4}.png:
Generated by pngTestFile in ../../png_test.go. Every vector is 7x5,
8-bit, non-interlaced, with pixel bytes specified by integer expressions
in that test. Types 0/2/3 include tRNS; indexed images include PLTE.
Two IDAT chunks split one zlib stream across a non-aligned boundary.
No downloaded inputs or external decoder implementation.

adam7-type-{0,2,3,4,6}-filter-{0,1,2,3,4}.png, adam7-160x120.png:
Generated by pngAdam7TestFile in ../../png_test.go — the same pixel
vectors lifted into the seven-pass Adam7 order (IHDR interlace method 1),
each pass filtered independently. The 160x120 RGB vector is also the
live-image-viewer gate leg's fixture (IPNG.PNG); its pixels are the
integer expressions above, checked host-side in that spec's scanout
probe.

The existing Go standard image/png, compress/zlib and hash/crc32 are
BSD-3-Clause host-only test references, not guest decoder dependencies.
